messages.text: I'm offering 85 P for Plaza de Olavide. That's a fair price given there's no clear market reference, and I'd like to close quickly since every tick of talk erodes value for both of us. If you're realistic, send a counter and we can get this done.
That figure is the same one you've already put forward, so it isn't really a move. I'm stepping up to 88 P as a show of good faith, and further movement from me depends on a real concession from you.
